about: The offertory antiphon of the Third Sunday of Advent, from Psalm 84. Its first two clauses are already sung at the introit of the same Mass.

s01.translation: You have blessed Your land, O Lord; You have ended Jacob's captivity and forgiven the iniquity of Your people.
